caption: The drawing is a rectangular embroidery featuring a two-story brick house with a blue door and six blue windows, set in the center foreground. The house has a brown roof with a single chimney. On either side of the house are two large green trees with textured brown trunks and branching leaves. Behind the house and trees is a fenced garden that contains green and pink horizontal rows that suggest cultivated plants or flowers. The ground in front of the house is represented by a large area of dense green stitching. The entire scene is bordered by an ornate floral vine made up of green stems, blue leaves, and pink and white flowers, with the vine looping around all four edges of the embroidery. Across the top, above the house and trees, is a stitched inscription in black thread that reads: "Sarah B Ward aged 11 years. August, 1822". The background material is a light tan fabric, and the embroidery is predominantly worked in green, blue, brown, pink, black, and white threads. The lower right corner outside the embroidery is labeled with the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" in small capital letters.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
